summary: The document contains code and logic for setting up and managing an assessment wizard in a web application. It includes definitions for various user interface controls, JavaScript functions, loading mechanisms, and handling both interim and final assessments. There are mechanisms for collecting and displaying answers from both students and instructors, as well as handling different sections of the assessment with conditional logic for displaying and requiring fields.
purpose: The primary purpose is to facilitate the setup, management, and completion of assessments within a web-based system, allowing for both student and instructor inputs to be captured and processed.

fields.name: assessorTypeCode
fields.description: Code identifying the type of assessor involved in the assessment.

fields.name: readOnly
fields.description: Boolean indicating if the assessment form is in read-only mode.

fields.name: placementRequestAssessmentID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the placement request assessment instance.

fields.name: placementRequestDestinationID
fields.description: Identifier for the destination of the placement request.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Manages the current user's session information, including language settings and permissions.

actors.name: Wizard1
actors.role: Represents the wizard control used for navigating through different steps of the assessment process.

actors.name: AssessmentSections
actors.role: Handles operations related to the sections of the assessment template.

workflows.name: Setup Assessment Wizard
steps: Initialize the wizard control and remove static steps.
Add dynamic steps based on assessment sections.
Append static steps like submit and complete at the end.

workflows.name: Load Assessment Page
steps: Setup assessment headers with dynamic content.
Register CSS styles dynamically for interim and final captions.

business_rules: Assessment sections are added to the wizard only if the applicable type codes match the current assessment's type.
Static wizard steps like submit and complete are added conditionally based on read-only status.
validations: If the current wizard step index is different from the next step index, the assessment form is reset.
Complete flags are set on UI elements based on section requirements.
conditions: Assessment sections and questions are only displayed if they are not optional or if they are required by the assessor type.
Grid format for question display is used based on control width and assessment type code.
system_behavior: Automatically setups the wizard and assessment form on page pre-initialization.
Handles events for next, previous, and sidebar button clicks in the wizard.

dependencies.description: References global resources used throughout the application.

exceptions.description: Raised if the expected report file for printing does not exist.
